description: This file manages agent configurations, including listing agents, resolving agent IDs, configs, workspaces, and directories, and handling agent session keys within an OpenClaw project.

classes.name: AgentEntry
classes.description: Type representing an agent configuration entry within the OpenClawConfig.

classes.name: ResolvedAgentConfig
classes.description: Type representing a fully resolved agent configuration with optional properties.

methods.name: listAgentEntries
methods.description: Returns a list of agent entries from the configuration.

methods.name: listAgentIds
methods.description: Returns a list of agent IDs from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentId
methods.description: Resolves the default agent ID, warning if multiple are marked default.

methods.name: resolveSessionAgentIds
methods.description: Resolves default and session-specific agent IDs based on session key and config.

methods.name: resolveSessionAgentId
methods.description: Returns the session agent ID based on session key and config.

methods.name: resolveAgentEntry
methods.description: Finds an agent entry by ID within the configuration.

methods.name: resolveAgentConfig
methods.description: Resolves the full agent configuration for a given agent ID.

methods.name: resolveAgentSkillsFilter
methods.description: Returns the effective skill filter for an agent.

methods.name: resolveAgentExplicitModelPrimary
methods.description: Resolves the explicit primary model for an agent.

methods.name: resolveAgentEffectiveModelPrimary
methods.description: Resolves the effective primary model considering defaults.

methods.name: resolveAgentModelPrimary
methods.description: Alias for resolveAgentExplicitModelPrimary.

methods.name: resolveAgentModelFallbacksOverride
methods.description: Resolves model fallbacks override for an agent.

methods.name: resolveFallbackAgentId
methods.description: Resolves the fallback agent ID based on explicit ID or session key.

methods.name: resolveRunModelFallbacksOverride
methods.description: Resolves model fallbacks override for a given configuration and agent/session context.

methods.name: hasConfiguredModelFallbacks
methods.description: Checks if there are configured model fallbacks for an agent.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveModelFallbacks
methods.description: Resolves effective model fallbacks considering session override.

methods.name: resolveAgentWorkspaceDir
methods.description: Resolves the workspace directory for an agent.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdsByWorkspacePath
methods.description: Finds agent IDs matching a workspace path.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdByWorkspacePath
methods.description: Returns the first agent ID matching a workspace path.

methods.name: resolveAgentDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory path for an agent.
